'''2004 North Dakota State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship scheduled for Saturday 12 June 2004 at 10:30 a.m. at Paradox Comics and Cards, 26 Roberts Street, Fargo, North Dakota, with [[Nick Kolnik]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3385-47002">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47002#47002 2004 North Dakota SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik (bluethrawn), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041031011758/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47002%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was a constructed tournament of six games and a final confrontation, with a $5.00 entry fee and decklists required. Trophies were to go to the winner and the runner-up, and the winner was to receive a bye into Day 2 of the World Championship at Gen Con ([[2004 World Championship]]). Every participant was to receive prizes, including uncut sheets, tournament foils, oversized cards and booster packs.<ref name="pcf-3385-47002" />

About 32 players took part.<ref name="pcf-5018-68750">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=68750#68750 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], Brian Herold (thepityofmrt), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 April 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The winner, [[Alden Peterson]], posted on the Players Committee forum as _maul, and was called "the defending 2004 ND Champ" when the 2005 championship was being scheduled. [[Peter Jacobson]] and his Owatonna crew came down the night before and stayed at the house of a local player, [[Kurt Schlichting]], where they spent the evening playtesting.<ref name="pcf-5018-70672">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=70672#70672 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], Brian Herold (thepityofmrt), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 April 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Players later recalled the playing room as one of the nicest basements the game had been played in, and air-conditioned.<ref name="pcf-5018-73666">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=73666#73666 ND States: June 25 - Ulimate Package Up For Grabs], Tyler Vastag (tvas27), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 May 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050830064902/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=72922%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Paradox Comics and Cards, 26 Roberts Street, Fargo, North Dakota<ref name="pcf-3385-47002" />
* '''Dates:''' 12 June 2004<ref name="pcf-3385-47002" />
* '''Time:''' 10:30 a.m.<ref name="pcf-3385-47002" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six games and a final confrontation; decklists required<ref name="pcf-3385-47002" />
* '''Fee:''' $5.00<ref name="pcf-3385-47002" />
* '''Players:''' about 32<ref name="pcf-5018-68750" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Kolnik]]<ref name="pcf-3385-47002" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Alden Peterson]]<ref name="pcf-5018-70672" />

On 20 April 2005, replying to a post by _maul, [[Brian Herold]] wrote that the 2005 championship would be played "without the defending 2004 ND Champ".<ref name="pcf-5018-70672" /> Peterson posted on the forum as _maul and signed his posts "alden peterson";<ref name="pcf-23634-342393">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342393#342393 Tournament Report], Alden Peterson (_maul), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 October 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081021234001/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=342847&sid=198be8cdf7bda3b05cc740ccf203ad9f Internet Archive]</ref> on 16 June 2004 he wrote that he had won a Death Star II Dark Side uncut rare sheet at the North Dakota State Championship.<ref name="pcf-223-47632">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47632#47632 SWCCG Collecting Questions??   Ask them Here!], Alden Peterson (_maul), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2004).
